import sys

def min_rest_days(n, activities):
    # Initialize DP table
    dp = [[0] * 4 for _ in range(n)]
    
    # Base case for the first day
    dp[0][0] = 1 if activities[0] == 0 else 0
    dp[0][1] = 1 if activities[0] == 1 else 0
    dp[0][2] = 1 if activities[0] == 2 else 0
    dp[0][3] = 1 if activities[0] == 3 else 0
    
    # Fill the DP table
    for i in range(1, n):
        if activities[i] == 0:
            dp[i][0] = min(dp[i-1][1], dp[i-1][2], dp[i-1][3]) + 1
            dp[i][1] = dp[i-1][0]
            dp[i][2] = dp[i-1][0]
            dp[i][3] = dp[i-1][0]
        elif activities[i] == 1:
            dp[i][0] = dp[i-1][1]
            dp[i][1] = min(dp[i-1][0], dp[i-1][2], dp[i-1][3]) + 1
            dp[i][2] = dp[i-1][1]
            dp[i][3] = dp[i-1][1]
        elif activities[i] == 2:
            dp[i][0] = dp[i-1][2]
            dp[i][1] = dp[i-1][2]
            dp[i][2] = min(dp[i-1][0], dp[i-1][1], dp[i-1][3]) + 1
            dp[i][3] = dp[i-1][2]
        elif activities[i] == 3:
            dp[i][0] = dp[i-1][3]
            dp[i][1] = dp[i-1][3]
            dp[i][2] = dp[i-1][3]
            dp[i][3] = min(dp[i-1][0], dp[i-1][1], dp[i-1][2]) + 1
    
    # The result is the minimum value in the last row of the DP table
    return min(dp[-1])

# Read input
n = int(sys.stdin.readline().strip())
activities = list(map(int, sys.stdin.readline().strip().split()))

# Print the result
print(min_rest_days(n, activities))
